name: Desperate Prayer
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details: You've caught the attention of our superiors, adventurer. They've asked you travel to the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind as soon as possible. Apparently they feel you've proven yourself already and are prepared to further your training. When you get there, find High Priestess Laurena. She will be able to guide you further. Good luck, and may the Light be with you.
narrative.objectives: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.
narrative.offerRewardText:
I'm glad you've arrived, adventurer. There are many things we will have to discuss, but more importantly is your training in the ways of the Light.

There are lessons all servants of the Light must learn. If you are ready, we'll begin discussing some of those now.
